result_summary.title: SSO redirect loop and missing password reset emails
result_summary.description: We have two high-impact issues with the SSO Integration Module in US-West Production. First, users are getting stuck in a redirect loop during login. Second, password reset emails are not being delivered to approximately 619 users. These issues are severely impacting user access. Please troubleshoot the authentication flow and email notification service.

The recommended next action is to verify the identity provider configuration and check for any recent changes or issues.
